LanguageData.MV_EnableProductionSpecialistOnlyBillAss: Enable Production Specialist Only Bill Assignment
Adds a work assignment restriction to production bills that restricts the bill to production specialists. Will only be visible if the player faction ideology has a production specialist role.
LanguageData.MV_EnableInspiredOnlyBillAssignmentToolt: Adds a work assignment restriction to production bills that restricts the bill to any pawn with a creativity inspiration.
LanguageData.MV_BillStoreModeTooltip: Default storage choice for production bills.
LanguageData.MV_BillRepeatModeTooltip: Default repeat choice for production bills.
LanguageData.MV_HitpointRangeToCountTooltip: Hitpoint range to count for TargetCount bills.
LanguageData.MV_QualityToCountMinTooltip: Minimum quality to count for TargetCount bills.
LanguageData.MV_QualityToCountMaxTooltip: Maximum quality to count for TargetCount bills.
LanguageData.MV_DisableClothTextileTooltip: Sets default ingredients for tailoring bills to not include cloth.
LanguageData.MV_DisableValuableTextilesTooltip: Sets default ingredients for tailoring bills to not include valuable textiles (devilstrand, hyperweave, synthread, thrumbofur, thrumbomane).
LanguageData.MV_DisableMoodImpactingTextilesTooltip: Sets default ingredients for tailoring bills to not include textiles that cause mood debuffs (human leather, dread leather).
LanguageData.MV_DisableColonistCremationTooltip: Sets default cremation bill on crematorium to not include colonists.
